title: Co-Annotator: Expert-Distilled ViT and VLM for Visual and Documentation Guidance in Age-Related Macular Degeneration
abstract: arXiv:2608.30352v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical AI often optimizes predictive performance without engaging how clinicians decide where to look and what to write. We present Co-Annotator, which distills expert gaze and dictation into two guidance components: a gaze-aligned Vision Transformer producing fixation-aligned areas of interest (AOIs), and an ontology-bounded vision-language model (VLM) that pre-fills editable biomarker summaries for retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT). We first collect expert gaze and dictations (US1) to train the models, significantly improving diagnostic accuracy and biomarker generation. We then deploy the system with ophthalmology residents: a controlled resident study (US2) confirmed each modality is safe and independently beneficial, with AOI guidance producing lasting perceptual efficiency gains through post-guidance carryover and VLM guidance more than doubling biomarker documentation breadth. translated_title: Co-Annotator：专家蒸馏的ViT与VLM用于年龄相关性黄斑变性的视觉与文档记录指导
translated_abstract: 临床AI通常只优化预测性能，而不关注临床医生如何决定看哪里以及写什么。我们提出了Co-Annotator，它将专家的注视和口述蒸馏为两个指导组件：一个注视对齐的视觉Transformer（ViT），生成与注视点对齐的感兴趣区域（AOIs）；以及一个受本体约束的视觉语言模型（VLM），为视网膜光学相干断层扫描（OCT）预填可编辑的生物标志物摘要。我们首先收集专家的注视数据和口述内容（US1）来训练模型，显著提高了诊断准确性和生物标志物生成效果。随后我们与眼科住院医师一起部署该系统：一项受控住院医师研究（US2）证实每种模态都是安全的且具有独立的益处，其中AOI指导通过指导后的延续效应产生了持久的感知效率提升，而VLM指导使生物标志物文档记录的广度增加了一倍以上。在两所学术机构的联合部署中……
tldr: 该论文提出Co-Annotator系统，将专家的注视模式与口述内容分别蒸馏为注视对齐的ViT引导组件和本体约束的VLM文档生成组件，显著提升了眼科住院医师诊断年龄相关性黄斑变性的准确性和生物标志物文档记录效率。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Co-Annotator, which distills expert gaze and dictation into a gaze-aligned ViT for visual guidance and an ontology-bounded VLM for biomarker documentation, significantly improving diagnostic accuracy and documentation efficiency for ophthalmology residents in age-related macular degeneration.
